name: Suzuka Circuit
notes: Suzuka Circuit, Grand Prix course (figure of eight, the lap crosses itself on a bridge before 130R). Raceway loop. The karting and leisure tracks in the park are excluded by name and id. The crossing needs no special handling: the bridge way shares no node with the track below. Traced 5757 m vs 5807 m. Start line from the middle of the pit lane. One DRS zone on the pit straight as in 2012. Values from 2012 F1: race laps, pit lane loss and overtaking are approximate. tyre_wear_mult and the wet weather multiplier are first guesses and will be tuned. speed_scale is 1.0 until the lap time calibration against the 2012 pole. pole_side is the inside of the first corner (approximate).
